_principle: Off-topic questions are classified by type, never counted by volume -- counting inverts the score on the best leads. Volunteered facts outrank the same fact pulled out by a direct question, because serious buyers leak their constraints while solving a real problem; tyre-kickers answer endlessly and reveal nothing.

keywords: who else has this builder delivered
adjacent.note: Off-topic by any classifier, but this is buyer-brain -- a family evaluating a home asks exactly these. Rewarded, not penalised.
adjacent.handling: Answer if a tool has it. Escalate if not. Never invent.

keywords: is now a good time to buy
personal_financial.note: Aspiration, not a prank. Low near-term intent, real long-term. Route to nurture, never discard.
personal_financial.handling: One line of human acknowledgment, decline the advice, redirect.

testing_the_bot.note: Probing the system, not the property. Strongest negative signal available.
testing_the_bot.handling: Brief decline, no lecture, redirect. Never get defensive.

volunteered_constraint.eg: my office is in Cyber City

volunteered_timeline.eg: we want to move before April

volunteered_family.eg: two kids, need a third room

_output_contract: Never emit a bare score. Always pair interest_level with interest_evidence[] -- the human-readable reasons that produced it.
